title: Fixed finite macroscopically separated order-one covariance mixtures retain the profiled coefficient

separated_class.hypothesis: Fix M independent of N. Each centered component is a stationary diagonal Gaussian with c_- S_N^*<=S_(N,i)<=c_+ S_N^* for fixed 0<c_-<=c_+<infinity. For every distinct pair, at least delta d_N cutoff modes satisfy |log(s_(i,k)/s_(j,k))|>=kappa for fixed delta,kappa>0.
separated_class.overlap_decay: For centered commuting Gaussians, BC_ij=product_k[2 sqrt(s_(i,k)s_(j,k))/(s_(i,k)+s_(j,k))]^(1/2). Each separated mode contributes at most q_kappa=sqrt(sech(kappa/2))<1, hence BC_ij<=q_kappa^(delta d_N)=exp[-c_(delta,kappa)d_N].
separated_class.prefactor: The K1606 score-polynomial factor is Tr[Omega B_ij H_ij B_ij]=sum_k 2 omega_k(s_(i,k)-s_(j,k))^2/[s_(i,k)s_(j,k)(s_(i,k)+s_(j,k))]. The fixed relative band around S_N^* bounds it by C_(c_-,c_+)Tr[Omega(S_N^*)^(-1)]=O_g(N^4).
separated_class.mixing_gain: With M fixed, K1606 gives 0<=sum_i p_i Q_N(nu_i)-Q_N(nu)<=C_(g,M,c_-,c_+,delta,kappa)N^4 exp(-cN^3)=o(1), because d_N=Theta(N^3).
separated_class.coefficient: K1572 bounds every admitted stationary diagonal Gaussian component below by lambda_N^prof, while the class contains the profiled Gaussian. Therefore inf Q_N(nu)=lambda_N^prof-o(1) and inf Q_N(nu)/N^4->h_g^prof.
separated_class.scope_guard: This crosses the shrinking-band restriction only for fixed finite centered mixtures whose distinct covariance components are macroscopically separated. Overlapping order-one components, M growing with N, translations with uncontrolled score moments, non-Gaussian components, phases, textures and nonstationarity remain open.
